claim_set.claim_text: Every AI-generated production action that moves toward a consequential effect — a mitigation applied, a rollback, a hotfix deployed, an infra-change committed, an alert suppressed, a customer status posted — MUST map to a recorded named-authority decision: the agent, the proposed action artefact, the intended consequential action class, and the named SRE / change-owner / incident-commander under whose delegated authority it proceeds. Actions lacking a recorded authority decision are refused at the action-admissibility gate.

Before an AI-generated production action proceeds to a consequential effect it MUST carry a recorded change-class due-diligence result — change-classification (standard / normal / emergency), a blast-radius / impact-and-rollback-plan assessment (NIST 800-53 CM-3/CM-4; Google SRE progressive-rollout & rollback-readiness), and a safety-floor / freeze-window / dependency screen where applicable. An unscreened, high-blast-radius, freeze-window, or rollback-plan-absent action is refused.

Every AI-generated production action that proceeds toward a consequential effect MUST emit a signed, replay-derivable provenance pin binding the generating model and version, the incident-intelligence inputs and pinned signals (the alert / incident ticket, root-cause hypothesis, detected blast radius, telemetry snapshot from the incident-intelligence tool), the change class and rollback plan applied, the due-diligence result relied on, and the named-authority outcome — audit-grade, NIST 800-53 CM-3 / SOC 2 CC8.1-aligned data-integrity provenance verifiable offline.

An AI-generated production action MUST remain advisory and MUST NOT drive a consequential effect until a named human reviewer — the on-call SRE, the incident commander, or the responsible change-owner — records sign-off. The irreversible / high-blast-radius rollback / hotfix-deployment / infra-change additionally requires §36 two-person sign-off (the proposing engineer AND an approving change-owner). Unreviewed AI-driven consequential production actions are refused and routed dual-channel.

KYE governs WHETHER an AI-driven production action may proceed to a consequential effect and PROVES the basis. KYE does not detect the incident, perform root-cause analysis, monitor the system, run the autoheal engine, or judge whether the fix is technically correct. Autoheal finds the fix; KYE proves the fix had authority.
